project.title: Hybrid First-Year Teaching Redesign with Virtual Learning Environments
project.objective: Redesign a first-year hybrid course to improve engagement and support diverse learners using a structured virtual learning environment.
deliverables: Revised course outline and weekly module plan
Set of digital lesson materials and lab resources
Assessment and feedback framework aligned to learning outcomes
Student support and inclusion plan for learning difficulties
VLE course shell fully configured and tested
Teaching team operations guide for hybrid delivery
constraints: Course must be ready before semester start in 21 days
All materials must comply with institutional accessibility standards
Assessments must align with existing programme learning outcomes
Use only institution-approved virtual learning environment tools
Limit synchronous sessions to timetable slots already allocated

risks.risk: VLE configuration not completed before semester start.
risks.mitigation: Prioritise core structure, use a checklist, and schedule early testing with IT support.

risks.risk: Materials not accessible for students with learning difficulties.
risks.mitigation: Apply accessibility checklist, consult student support officer, and pilot with a small student group.

risks.risk: Assessment changes conflict with programme requirements.
risks.mitigation: Align assessment map with programme outcomes and get early sign-off from programme coordinator.

risks.risk: Teaching team inconsistent in applying new feedback and inclusion practices.
risks.mitigation: Create a concise teaching guide, run a short calibration session, and review after first assessment.

themes.why_relevant: Lecturers must align in-person and online components into a coherent learning journey.
Team needs consistent assessment criteria and feedback practices across all groups.
Course must proactively address diverse needs and comply with inclusion policies.
VLE is the main hub for content, labs, and communication in the hybrid model.
Multiple lecturers must coordinate schedules, labs, and communication to avoid confusion.

backlog.task: Draft revised course outline and weekly module structure for the hybrid format
definition_of_done: Course outline includes weekly topics, modes (online/on-site), and learning outcomes
Outline aligns with programme learning outcomes
Outline shared with programme coordinator for review

backlog.task: Design assessment plan and rubrics aligned with learning outcomes
definition_of_done: Assessment map lists all tasks, weightings, and deadlines
Rubrics created for each major assessment
Assessment plan validated against programme requirements

backlog.task: Prepare core digital lesson materials for first four weeks
definition_of_done: Slides, readings, and activities uploaded to VLE for weeks 1–4
Materials follow accessibility guidelines
Links and files tested from a student view

backlog.task: Configure VLE course shell with modules, gradebook, and attendance tracking
definition_of_done: VLE has weekly modules with placeholders for content
Gradebook reflects assessment plan
Attendance and announcement tools configured and tested

backlog.task: Create inclusion and learning difficulties support plan
definition_of_done: Plan lists specific adjustments and support strategies
Plan reviewed with student support officer
Summary shared with teaching team

backlog.task: Develop lab and practical session guidelines for hybrid delivery
definition_of_done: Guidelines cover safety, preparation, and remote alternatives
Checklist for lab supervision created
Guidelines uploaded to VLE and shared with lab staff

backlog.task: Define communication and feedback norms for the teaching team
definition_of_done: Response time expectations and channels documented
Feedback turnaround times agreed
Norms shared in channel and stored in team guide

backlog.task: Set up attendance and participation tracking process
definition_of_done: Process defined for recording attendance in VLE and on-site
Template created for weekly participation notes
Process tested in a mock session

backlog.task: Create a short orientation module for students in the VLE
definition_of_done: Orientation module explains course structure and tools
Includes a low-stakes quiz to confirm understanding
Module visible to students before week 1

backlog.task: Develop constructive feedback examples and comment bank
definition_of_done: Comment bank covers common strengths and issues
Examples aligned with rubrics and inclusive language
Shared with all lecturers and uploaded to team space

backlog.task: Plan and schedule early student check-in and support touchpoints
definition_of_done: Schedule for check-ins in weeks 2 and 4 created
Process for flagging at-risk students defined
Plan shared with student support officer

backlog.task: Compile teaching team operations guide for the hybrid course
definition_of_done: Guide consolidates outline, assessments, norms, and support plan
Guide reviewed by at least two lecturers
Final version stored in shared drive and linked in VLE

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on overall hybrid course structure and weekly plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message sharing the first draft of the course outline.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve or adjust the proposed weekly structure and learning outcomes.
Decide which topics are delivered online vs on-site in the first four weeks.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize assessment plan, rubrics, and feedback approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Post draft assessment map and rubrics for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm assessment types, weightings, and deadlines for the course.
Agree on shared feedback standards and use of the comment bank.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define inclusion strategies and support for learning difficulties.
threads_plan.trigger: Share draft inclusion and support guide for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select core adjustments and support practices to apply across all groups.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock down VLE configuration, orientation module, and tracking processes.
threads_plan.trigger: Update on VLE shell setup and orientation module status.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve VLE structure and navigation for students.
Agree on the attendance and participation tracking method.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on hybrid lab/practical procedures and team operations guide.
threads_plan.trigger: Share draft lab guidelines and operations guide for final review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on lab procedures and the consolidated teaching operations guide.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in on progress against key tasks and blockers.
Weekly review of VLE readiness and content gaps before the next teaching week.
Post-assessment debrief thread to refine rubrics and feedback practices.
Mid-project checkpoint to adjust inclusion strategies based on early student signals.
